text: I think that’s the last of the  Libre 14 and Libre 2, they are moving on to Libre 3 Plus. I’m sure those would be okay to use but I would let Abbott know they sent expired sensors.

text: Contact where you got them from.I had some expired ones from Walmart.And they exchange them for more current ones.
